limits: Exact native bossGladiator / enBossGladiator / renderer 121272 source assignment only; visible companion surfaces do not credit their sibling topology groups or renderer sources.
The ordinary no-focus hit reduced the same target from 11 HP to 6 HP; death used the explicit KillSingle fixture at 6 HP and is not ordinary lethal-damage evidence.
Eighteen selected original PNGs were reviewed; the remaining 312 retained capture frames and generated videos are preserved evidence but were not individually reviewed.

The death capture retained 90 of 120 requested frames, then ended at a verified controller-unresolved boundary after a pinned native Death trigger; full-duration death and later corpse visibility are not claimed.
Structured capture records m_DoRagdoll true and 11 active rigid bodies becoming nonkinematic from retained death frame 28; the claim is limited to the sampled visible ragdoll prefix.

Native helmet, shield, weapon, combat UI, effects, foreground hero, depth blur, and camera motion limit fine surface inspection; no sampled tearing, renderer loss, viewport-edge clipping, floor fall-through, or multipart separation was observed.
Other proficiencies, DeathLight, portrait, collision, extended culling, long-session resource lifetime, full campaign completion, and final art-direction approval remain outside this archive.
